purpose: Measure original A32 render functions without replacing their bodies
abi: A32 object argument in r0; audited sites do not consume stack arguments. Wrapper saves r4/LR with 8-byte alignment. Host bridge preserves GPR/VFP/FPSCR. r12 selects the site/trampoline and is AAPCS caller-scratch.
guards: Loader verifies module identity; patch validates every immutable range and first word before writing any site, then checks alignment, capacity and A32 branch reach. Shared/out-of-line tails are not claimed to be covered by a contiguous guard range.
limitations: Wall time includes blocking, platform bridge and scheduling. Per-thread parent/child and worker overlap must be subtracted, not added. Exceptions through probe wrappers and hardware are unverified.
